reviews.text: Been going to Atelier for a year and I love it! Aria is a fabulous stylist and is so fun to talk to! My hair is healthy and looks great after every session. Truly cannot recommend her or the salon enough!
Aria has always done a phenomenal job on my hair. It always looks like what I wanted when we’re done. She is very kind and sweet always asks the correct questions! I would definitely recommend her!
Got my hair blown out by Kendal and she did a fantastic job. I absolutely loved my experience. She was very detailed, easy to talk to, friendly and did a great job.
